title: Connectivity problem reaching Share servers
symptom: Since approximately 8.30am CET on April 9th I get the problem "Connectivity problem reaching Share servers". I use dexcom share/ follow to get readings for my xdrip app and nightscout website. The website didn't get readings since ca. 1am the same day. So both sources have a problem getting share data. Interestingly enough, my dexcom follower through the official app still get readings without any changes. The exact wording in the event log of xdrip is the following: "Get Share Data Failed: java.io.EOFException: End of input at line 1 column 1 path $"
cause: It seems that the problem is because of other character then a-z in the user name. See the discussion in nightscout/cgm-remote-monitor#5608. Unfortunately you can't switch the user name. You have to set up a new account.
fix: You have to set up a new Dexcom account with a username containing only a-z characters. Instructions are provided in a linked document.
